description: Integrating Climate Change into the Planning and Operations of the Apostle Islands National Lakeshore, WI is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); NPS Apostle Islands National Lakeshore. The Apostle Islands National Lakeshore (APIS) in Wisconsin is integrating climate change in its planning and operations. APIS became a member of the National Park Service’s Climate Friendly Parks program in March 2008 and is incorporating the overall National Park Service Climate Change Response Strategy into sustainability efforts on site. Coverage: Apostle Islands, WI (2011). The toolkit gives Apostle Islands, WI as the location, 2011 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
